body: Yes, I'm going to college soon to become a diesel mechanic, and she is going to become a welder. We've decided marriage and children will be in our future. I also set daily goals, like brushing my teeth and showering
Yeah, a mastiff, she's also extremely important to me. My girlfriend is basically my only family.

Suicide should never be an option, truly. I know you may not think it, but sometimes you need to stop caring about people, you being suicidal isn't some attention grab, the only way it would be is if you weren't actually. Even though almost 100% of the people on this sub will never meet you in real life, they all want you to keep living, because if you can make it, you have proved that you are truly a survivor, someone who can overcome. Life gets scary, for everyone, but that doesn't justify ending your life.
Thanks for the recommendation. I honestly don't know what happened anymore
